title: Scrambled Xenopus tadpole faces reach a normal frog face by new paths

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Scrambled Xenopus tadpole faces reach a normal frog face by new paths

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: During metamorphosis, Xenopus laevis tadpoles reach the correct frog face configuration not only from a normal tadpole configuration but also from a wide range of experimentally scrambled craniofacial configurations, using new paths through morphospace that end in the same goal region.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Bioelectric networks: the cognitive glue enabling evolutionary scaling from physiology to mind

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2023, Bioelectric networks: the cognitive glue enabling evolutionary scaling from physiology to mind › Basal cognition without neurons: what dynamic bodies think about › Navigation: an invariant between morphological, behavioral, and other spaces

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: For example, during metamorphosis, the tadpole of Xenopus laevis can reach the correct frog face region of morphospace not only from its default starting position (a normal tadpole configuration), but also from a wide range of scrambled configurations (Vandenberg et al. 2012)—using new paths through that morphospace that nevertheless end up in the same goal region (Friston et al. 2015; Pezzulo and Levin 2016).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Bioelectric networks: the cognitive glue enabling evolutionary scaling from physiology to mind”, Animal cognition (2023), doi:10.1007/s10071-023-01780-3; section “Basal cognition without neurons: what dynamic bodies think about › Navigation: an invariant between morphological, behavioral, and other spaces”. Scope: Xenopus laevis tadpoles with induced craniofacial malformations (author's lab, Vandenberg et al. 2012)

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-glue-18: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.65

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Convergence in morphometric space is straightforward to define and published images can test representative trajectories. Incomplete public longitudinal data limit coverage of the claimed wide range of starting configurations.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Track craniofacial landmarks through metamorphosis in normal and experimentally scrambled tadpoles and test whether distinct starting configurations converge into the normal adult-face region.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Defining the normal goal region requires a prespecified reference distribution.

Longitudinal raw landmark coordinates may not be public.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data existence: 0.55
discriminating power: 0.72
analysis feasibility: 0.72
operationalizability: 0.88
data adequacy: 0.44

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The primary study is a public geometric morphometric series with a defined landmark scheme and canonical variate tests across months of tadpole life. Without the coordinate file, a new worker can re-read the published separations but cannot recompute individual trajectories. The data can test return toward normal for some structures in this one species, and they are weaker for a single shared goal region reached by new paths.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Using the published 32-landmark scheme, compute Procrustes distance of scrambled versus unperturbed tadpoles to the normal frog-face configuration at successive ages, separately for jaws, branchial arches, eyes, nostrils and otoliths. Convergence of scrambled animals onto the control region along trajectories that normal animals do not follow would support the claim; persistent separation, or correction of only some structures, would restrict it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Landmark coordinates are published as analyses, not as a downloadable coordinate table.

Age-binned group averages do not reconstruct individual paths through morphospace.

Jaws and branchial arches are scored separately from eyes, nostrils and otoliths, so one face-wide goal region is an extra summary.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.82
data existence: 0.46
discriminating power: 0.55
data adequacy: 0.4
analysis feasibility: 0.38
